text: {"A": {"fidelity": 5, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": []}, "B": {"fidelity": 2, "omitted": ["cħaaba ('take care' / 'beware')", "ca tu ꝑitah ('then he departed')"], "added": ["\"bearing the marks of the lashes\""], "mistranslated": ["tacitac û tuculic ('immediately thinking') -> 'whenever he thought of it'", "ichticilyà ('in anguish and fear') -> 'at once'", "utial tan apactic ù lobil à belob ca à hach okte à kebanob ('so that seeing the wickedness of your conduct you might bitterly weep for your sins') -> 'I have been watching your wicked ways, waiting for you to weep bitterly for your sins'", "tan úpactic û xotol û kin ('awaiting the end of his life/days') -> 'watching for the rising of the sun'", "y ù noc kixob ('with a garment of thorns') -> 'bearing the marks of the lashes'", "tuchun lay Kohãlae ('to the bedside of this sick man') -> 'the head of the sick man's bed'", "ma hakotzil ca chacanacentii ('do not be afraid that I appear to you') -> 'It is no wonder that I resemble him'", "ù hach yail tin Uol ù Zatal Uinicoob ('because the loss of men grieves my heart so deeply') -> 'the great love in my heart for the loss of men'"]}, "better": "A", "comment": "Translation A is remarkably accurate and complete, whereas Translation B commits multiple serious mistranslations of grammatical subjects and key theological terms, alongside omissions and an invented phrase."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 3, "omitted": ["Ɔocebali tun ('Finally' / 'In conclusion')", "t huntenile ('forever' / 'eternally')", "paibentzil ('necessary' / 'essential')"], "added": ["One day", "of its own", "This cannot be so for you:"], "mistranslated": ["we cannot do this: we look at ourselves ... our shadow -> This cannot be so for you: when you look at yourselves ... your shadow", "as we say -> who, as you say", "our love -> your love", "as we were born/created -> as you were born", "what we think -> what you think", "existed before -> was born before", "it is very necessary that we believe -> Believe very firmly", "delusion / phantom -> only a reflection"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 3, "omitted": ["hebal c tucliceex ('that which we think / what we think')", "tech ('to you')", "Calam ('greatly / intensely')"], "added": ["Refers to Henricus Gandavensis (Henry of Ghent, c. 1217–1293), a prominent scholastic theologian known in Spanish tradition as Enrique de Gante or Enrique Gran."], "mistranslated": ["so it moves too / likewise it moves -> and it stops moving as well", "nor can He/it be deceived [passive] -> and it cannot deceive", "when we eat / as we have eaten -> that come when we sleep", "or other things, turning your back on the true God -> or when you turn your backs on the true God for something else"]}, "better": "A", "comment": "Translation A is better because Translation B invents that the reflection stops moving, omits the phrase about what we think, mistranslates the passive verb for being deceived, and adds a historically false identification of Enrique Gran, whereas A's errors are primarily shifts from first-person plural inclusive to second-person pronouns."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 2, "omitted": [], "added": ["shone"], "mistranslated": ["above his magnificent youthful form -> upon his shoulder", "great terror/misery such as me -> with such great whiteness as this", "hope of the lost -> praise of the lost", "these few tears of my eyes, with which I weep for my sin -> this mark of blood on my face, which I received for my sin", "confession has very great strength in its hands -> the tears of true confession have very great strength", "even though it was very terrible -> and they are greatly to be revered"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 5, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": []}, "better": "B", "comment": "Translation B is completely accurate and faithful throughout, whereas Translation A suffers from multiple severe mistranslations, including rendering the tears wept for sin as a mark of blood on the face."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 3, "omitted": ["lalaci (continually/unceasingly)"], "added": ["First"], "mistranslated": ["u lohul u chucanob (redemption of the others/the rest) -> redemption of captives", "cichcelemil, hach dzibolan ti alakoob (beauty/handsomeness, so coveted by concubines/women) -> youthful vigor gone, so praised by your companions", "lobol lakilob (wicked companions/friends) -> wicked pleasures", "tu nukul tu betah (they did it with good cause/justly) -> for all that you did", "culpachticoob (renounce/abandon them) -> confess them", "h ma cux ol (senseless/foolish person) -> ungrateful one"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 3, "omitted": ["elder (in Zucune, elder brother)"], "added": ["so that your great shame may be made complete", "at once", "to Him"], "mistranslated": ["kahez dzocan a manzic u yanalob asab nohob (remember that you have already come through others that were greater) -> remember that after you endure it, other and greater things will come", "u thibete hach chacan tiob layob catulob t maniebe (plainly resembling those two who had passed before) -> to visit him, appearing clearly to both of them who were passing the night there", "hoch bilan (wasted away/exhausted) -> pale as a shadow", "alabolal (hope) -> faith"]}, "better": "A", "comment": "While B correctly identifies several colonial Maya idioms that A misses, A is better overall because B severely distorts the brother's reassurance about past illnesses into an omen of future suffering and completely mangles the final apparition of the Trinity."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 3, "omitted": ["bin c yacunteex ('whom we shall love')", "u nucul ('the reason')"], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["caat emi (descended) -> wished to come down"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 5, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": []}, "better": "B", "comment": "Translation B is complete and faithful to the Maya text, whereas Translation A omits the opening clause 'bin c yacunteex' and mistranslates the completive verb 'emi' (descended) as 'wished to come down'."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 2, "omitted": ["ú ɔálpach (turning their backs on devotions)"], "added": ["Sins are taken up"], "mistranslated": ["le kabóob cú lubulóob ti (the hands fall down) -> The inspirations that come to it", "le pacatóob cú kalicubaóob (the eyes close) -> the glances of grace turned toward it", "le xicnóob má tu yubicóob (the ears do not hear) -> the words it no longer understands, though they are heard", "tioklalcá cú ɔilibintic, iix cú kexuolaltabal (so that it causes loathing and is rejected) -> so that it provokes anger and earns reproach", "xnokolilóob ti tuil cuxtal (worms of a corrupt life) -> The pleasures of a wicked life increase", "cheh bacilil (a mockery) -> a dry trunk", "iix má tu yiláal ù yanal báal cá ú yetez chiculilóob (nor is anything else seen displaying signs) -> Nothing else is seen in it but traces", "tipàan olmail (exceedingly difficult) -> pitiful", "anaci ú tħancóob... Jesu-Cristo hebic tu mentah le ah nucteil (unless they call upon Jesus Christ as the ruler did) -> unless Jesus Christ had called it... as he did for the ruler", "cach téex humpel kab (broke an arm) -> received a wound", "cexi cá anac ú toholtic yabalóob yailóob iix kinilé (even if it cost much pain and time) -> and it would heal its pain and sickness", "leti kab chupi (the arm swelled) -> then when the wound festers", "cà le cuchil cimpahané tu zatahuƀa ú chucáan (and the deadened flesh corrupted the rest) -> the injured part grows worse", "leti ù ɔácal (its cure/healing) -> the wound"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["náapzahàanil má tu heɔcuntic (experience does not confirm it) -> if it is constantly delayed, it does not settle", "mazubtalil (shamelessness) -> shame"]}, "better": "B", "comment": "Translation B is remarkably faithful and precise across nearly the entire text, whereas Translation A repeatedly mistranslates concrete anatomical terms and idioms, turning hands, eyes, ears, worms, and a broken arm into inaccurate abstractions."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 2, "omitted": ["kaƀet ú ɔáƀal tu zeƀlacil le ɔác ti keƀan (the remedy for sin must be given promptly)", "ti téel luké (in that mud)", "c paymaéex (we urge you)"], "added": ["the sinner's rising becomes harder the longer the fall into sin lasts", "and to Him"], "mistranslated": ["if we call upon him promptly -> he calls you at once", "it may be out of great goodness and weakness rather than stubborn obstinacy -> because he wishes his great goodness and mercy to be honored", "the severe violence of temptation rather than purposeful contempt; great power of another rather than freedom in the very same will -> He shows great power in his testing, and gives the means to hold back; great strength in another, and the swiftness of his will", "spurning the hand that God extends in His desire to deliver him -> He hinders the good that God wished to do in trying to raise him", "love of his God (yacunah) -> the strength of his God", "we remain distant from the majesty/presence of God -> you remain enemies of God", "spiritual coldness and sloth in your calling upon the Pardoner -> when He calls you to forgiveness without being heeded", "ask for it (káatic) -> receive them"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 5, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": []}, "better": "B", "comment": "Translation B is an exceptionally precise and faithful rendering of the colonial Maya text, whereas Translation A invents clauses, reverses agent and patient, mistranslates core vocabulary such as yacunah, and marks difficult lines as unclear."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 2, "omitted": ["á zàat-zahul (your forgiveness)", "zinil kaƀ (outstretched hand)"], "added": ["come"], "mistranslated": ["cá ɔoc c luƀuléex... ti c pixanéex (we have fallen... in our souls) -> you have fallen... Let your souls have", "cici kaholmá (know well) -> heard well", "le cú tiilticóob uincilé (what cures/relieves the body) -> what pains the body", "hele... yaƀóob hakoƀilóob (today... many wonders/marvels) -> then... many sinners", "ú helel (to rest) -> their change", "ti zeƀchilah (with haste/urgency) -> in prophecy", "cú nahmaticóob humpel hach pelelil ɔá uol (deserve the most earnest attention) -> bring on a very great dread in the heart", "táan ú zeƀchitic (is swiftly causing/bringing on) -> is foretelling"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 5, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["le káaxóob (the forests/bush country) -> the mountains"]}, "better": "B", "comment": "Translation B is exceptionally accurate and captures difficult Maya theological phrasing and idioms precisely, whereas Translation A commits numerous severe mistranslations of roots and vocabulary throughout the page."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 2, "omitted": ["in haste (ti zebchilah)", "from your child (ti á ual)"], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["the soul trembles and one's blood curdles -> as a thing most certainly to be seen, and blood will flow", "he punishes us with many afflictions -> it leads us astray, and the many evils that exist today foretell it", "loving one / father -> Strengthener", "help me by asking from your child -> I ask you for", "answer me -> receive it", "how perfect are his words -> though his words are few", "their grievous afflictions -> his many mercies", "good ways / virtues -> reproaches", "all his perfections -> all those severe things", "in his writing -> in his holiness", "doctrine / instruction -> prophecy"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["as you know -> not one of us knows"]}, "better": "B", "comment": "Translation B is substantially more accurate and faithful to the colonial Maya text, whereas Translation A contains numerous serious mistranslations that invert the meaning of key theological terms."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 5, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": []}, "B": {"fidelity": 2, "omitted": ["m atáan (not, in 'm atáan ú ɔabal antahul')"], "added": ["<note>The phrase \"kazil ɔilib\" is rendered here following Ripalda's Spanish, which speaks of giving good advice.</note>"], "mistranslated": ["tzicbenil (respect/reverence) -> peace", "yuntzilóob y le palilóob (masters and servants) -> fathers with their children", "palilóob y le yumtzilóob (servants and masters) -> children with their fathers", "báax cú uetħic chucanil (what does it completely forbid) -> what does this commandment, \"do not kill,\" require", "Yan ú chucanil ti leitió ú yánalóob nuculóob ti cimzah? (Are there other ways belonging to killing?) -> Is there any obligation toward others to keep them from death?", "kazil ɔilib (bad example) -> good counsel", "m atáan ú ɔabal antahul (not giving help) -> by giving help"]}, "better": "A", "comment": "Translation A is completely accurate and faithful to the source, whereas Translation B makes numerous severe errors, including mistranslating masters and servants as parents and children, translating 'forbid' as 'require', and inverting prohibitions regarding bad example and withholding help into positive actions."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 2, "omitted": ["ah ƀolóob cá ti (sellers so that)", "tancaƀ (courtyard/outside)", "in náat (my understanding) in yohel in náat"], "added": ["my children", "buying and", "which is only fit to be called a den of thieves", "Christian"], "mistranslated": ["Ilaéex ('see/behold') -> 'You know well'", "h tamanóob, le mehen uacxóob ('sheep, young oxen') -> 'oxen, little sheep'", "In heláancuntah ('changed/altered') -> 'Remember now'", "Ahzáat-zahuléex / Ahzáat-zah zipil ('Savior / Forgiver of sins') -> 'sinners'", "Cá c tzayéex ('let us apply') -> 'Let me now bring to mind'", "camƀezah ('teaching') -> 'the evils'", "ti hach nohochil hatzul ('in the greater part') -> 'and of very great moment'", "Cóonéex tioklal hatzulilóob ('let us proceed by parts') -> 'Listen, for they are grave matters'"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 5, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": []}, "better": "B", "comment": "Translation B is an exceptionally accurate rendering of the Yucatec Maya text, whereas Translation A suffers from multiple serious mistranslations, vocabulary inversions, and an interpolated phrase imported from biblical memory."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 3, "omitted": ["cú nahaltic (he gains merit)"], "added": ["if he does not take pleasure in them"], "mistranslated": ["Mayli (rather / on the contrary) -> No", "le nuculóob kebané (the occasions of sin) -> the sinful thoughts", "ti ú yalahul (with deliberation) -> with his will"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["Le xmá tiblil (idleness / ociosidad) -> Bad conduct"]}, "better": "B", "comment": "B is better because A hallucinates a condition and misses that resisting bad thoughts gains merit, whereas B translates that theological exchange accurately and only commits a minor lexical slip on idleness."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 2, "omitted": [], "added": ["or the harm that they did"], "mistranslated": ["is it enough to confess their sin? -> enter into the forgiveness of their sin?", "to its owner -> from their neighbor", "endless things -> when they are untrue"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 5, "omitted": [], "added": ["worldly"], "mistranslated": []}, "better": "B", "comment": "B accurately translates the Yucatec Maya catechism idioms and vocabulary, whereas A adds an unprompted clause and makes several serious errors of sense, notably confusing confession with forgiveness and endless things with untruth."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 3, "omitted": [], "added": ["for His benefits", "for our sins"], "mistranslated": ["ti máax c paymá tulul tzic (to whom supreme reverence is due) -> the one we call the Holy Father", "Bahun ti ú yabal misa (Since Mass is spoken of) -> Since you are told to hear Mass", "cá cú mentáal ti Cristo (that is made of Christ) -> that is made to Christ", "Ti h maxulunté Yum (To the Infinite Lord) -> To the Lord God"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 5, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": []}, "better": "B", "comment": "Translation B is a faithful and accurate rendering of the Yucatec Maya text, whereas Translation A substitutes passages from the Spanish Ripalda catechism, introducing multiple mistranslations and extraneous phrases."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 2, "omitted": ["cú uetħelóob (are forbidden) in the second question", "cú laytal (from them arise) in the second answer"], "added": ["for one's living", "and is not on the right path", "people's"], "mistranslated": ["cú uetħelóob (are forbidden) -> are there special commandments about", "zazilcuntic (to make clear / illuminate) -> kept", "cú laytal ... lobil (from them evil arises) -> can be evil", "pecuolalóob (affections of the will / inclinations) -> desires"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": ["tipáan éma (moreover and) in the first question"], "added": ["the Law of"], "mistranslated": ["ú yanal tioklal tu beil tibilil (for other purposes in a proper way) -> other than for a good purpose", "y ꝑelelil (particular / specific) -> these", "cú uetħelóob (are forbidden) -> coveted"]}, "better": "B", "comment": "Translation B is significantly more faithful, correctly rendering key terms like 'zazilcuntic' (make clearer) and 'pecuolalóob' (inclinations), whereas Translation A commits multiple omissions and errors of sense by relying on Spanish catechism paraphrases."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 2, "omitted": ["ra hilaxic paru vi (reading it over him)"], "added": ["when a person is gravely ill", "at the hour of a person's death"], "mistranslated": ["tu gunih vi (takes effect) -> is fittingly granted to him", "tu ni ma coꜭhih vi vinak ꜭhivꜯiriçabal (a person receives the grant of absolution) -> he makes use of this Bull", "tok ruꜯiriçax (when he is absolved) -> when he makes use of this Bull", "tahilax paru vi (it is read over him) -> it is applied to him"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": ["or"], "mistranslated": ["pa ꜭhavomariçabal hay (in the house of cleansing [Purgatory]) -> in the hospital", "ru ꜯiriçaxic (absolution / being absolved) -> its being applied"]}, "better": "B", "comment": "Translation B closely follows the Kaqchikel syntax and vocabulary, whereas Translation A invents grave illness and the hour of death out of place, omits the liturgical reading over the person, and repeatedly substitutes generic paraphrases for the actual verbs."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 2, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["ru nima hoyeuaxic (great mercy / pardon) -> it is greatly to be honored", "ah ghumum, ah ꜫatat gux (humbled, contrite of heart) -> proud, hard-hearted", "ah biꜯ (sorrowful ones) -> songsters", "ah ahil (afflicted ones) -> merrymakers", "ꜭhibiꜯ (with sorrow) -> and with hymns"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 3, "omitted": ["ti vagaxah (you should hear)", "tan ti giꜯ ruça ꜭh (while the priest gives absolution / forgives)"], "added": ["Only then", "for this pardon to come to us"], "mistranslated": ["ꜭhiroꜫexic (weeping over / lamenting) -> wanting to declare", "ru ꜭhoh mil vae (the proper order / rectitude of this) -> what is needed for this pardon to come to us"]}, "better": "B", "comment": "B correctly understands the penitential theology and vocabulary of the passage (recognizing pardon and sorrow), whereas A confuses Kaqchikel bis (sorrow) with bix (song) to absurdly turn weeping penitents into merrymaking songsters."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 2, "omitted": ["ꜭhic (already)"], "added": ["and taken away"], "mistranslated": ["ꜭhirughumumibal (with groaning) -> with the crushing", "vꜯ ta ka banom ꜭhic ... xax ti ka ban vij (although we have already made ... we must indeed still perform) -> If we have made ... well, only then do we truly perform", "paru ꜭhij (from its heat) -> from its hands", "ti gex va ꜭhi bex (it is exchanged/commuted) -> taken away", "ꜭhiru pokonariçabal, ꜭhiru ra[yibal] (into its suffering, into its torment) -> with its punishment and its misery"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 5, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": []}, "better": "B", "comment": "B accurately renders the Kaqchikel syntax, vocabulary, and theological argument concerning the commutation of eternal punishment into temporal penance, whereas A introduces multiple serious mistranslations and reverses the meaning of the final clause."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["tobal (help/succor) -> a ransom"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 2, "omitted": ["çaꜭhibal mac (remission of sins)"], "added": ["which are given", "you must take", "give your alms for it", "you must give your alms for it"], "mistranslated": ["pahuley (in the pit/chasm) -> in the fire", "ca ca huna (every two years) -> each year", "xa ca ca ꜭhihuna (only for two years) -> only year by year", "cay ꜭhihuna (the two years) -> year", "tan tihath, tantiya (it is offered and granted) -> This you must take, and you must give your alms for it", "tan tiya ꜭhivi ꜭhiki ꜭhin (it is given to them) -> you must give your alms for it"]}, "better": "A", "comment": "Translation A is vastly superior and remarkably accurate, correctly understanding the grammar, counterfactual clauses, and the two-year term of the Bull, whereas Translation B misses numbers, hallucinates commands to pay alms, and omits the remission of sins."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 2, "omitted": ["ka ꜯol ꜫomibal kij (wasting/spending days)", "haga tan ti gamon vi lo (and it is now received from this)"], "added": ["our fasting", "and our mortification"], "mistranslated": ["kuꜯilah banoh (good works) -> our penance", "ruꜫat bal (putting an end to / intercepting) -> the gift", "ꜭhica nih- (immediately) -> however great", "haga tan ti gamon vi lo (and it is now received from this) -> And if he should die"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["ꜭhavomariçabal hay (house of cleansing/purification) -> house of torment", "xka gux laah (we remembered / took care) -> they did not take care"]}, "better": "B", "comment": "B accurately translates nearly the entire text and its complex grammatical constructions, whereas A fabricates penances not in the Kaqchikel text and completely mistranslates the final sentence."}
